explain: Todo runs with no settings: without an issuer registration it keeps each list in the browser and says accounts are coming soon. These settings turn on Breakthrough account sign-in and the saved list in Production. The Preview registration is scoped to the feat/todo-account-journeys branch, which this doctor does not read.

env.why: The issuer origin plus /api/auth (https://accounts.royeradames.com/api/auth). Without it, accounts stay off and Todo says they are coming soon.
env.agentFix: Once Todo is registered on the production issuer, run `vercel env add AUTH_ISSUER_URL production --no-sensitive` with the exact issuer URL, then redeploy.

env.why: Todo's client ID on the issuer, issued for its exact callback and sign-out addresses. Without it, accounts stay off.
env.agentFix: Register Todo on https://accounts.royeradames.com with royer-auth's connect-app.mjs (callback https://todo-app.royeradames.com/api/auth/federation/callback), which writes the client ID and secret to Vercel Production without printing them.

env.why: Proves Todo to the issuer when it exchanges a sign-in code. Without it, accounts stay off; if it leaks, another app could pose as Todo.
env.agentFix: Written Sensitive by royer-auth's connect-app.mjs during registration; never printed or pasted.

env.why: Todo's own key (32+ characters) for signing its session cookies. Without it, accounts stay off; if it leaks, sessions can be forged.
env.agentFix: Pipe a fresh random value straight in: `openssl rand -hex 32 | vercel env add AUTH_SECRET production --sensitive`, never printed.

env.why: Todo's exact public origin (https://todo-app.royeradames.com). Sign-in refuses requests addressed to any other host.
env.agentFix: Run `vercel env add AUTH_BASE_URL production --no-sensitive` with https://todo-app.royeradames.com.

env.why: Pooled connection to Todo's Production database, which holds each account's principals, sessions and saved list. Without it, accounts stay off.
env.agentFix: Create a separate Free Neon store for Production through the existing Vercel Neon integration (terms already accepted), connect it to Production only, then apply the reviewed migrations with `npm run db:migrate`. The integration manages the value.

env.why: Direct connection used only by the reviewed migration scripts; runtime never reads it.
env.agentFix: Provisioned by the same Neon integration connection as DATABASE_URL.

probes.name: production list answers
probes.ifFails: Check the todo-app.royeradames.com domain on the Vercel project and that Deployment Protection is all_except_custom_domains.
